sources.snippet: In the first stage, we "warm up" the model by distilling Long CoTs from a toy domain, namely, Knights \& Knaves (K\&K) logic puzzles to acquire general reasoning skills. In the second stage, we apply RLVR to the warmed-up model using a limited set of target-domain examples.

sources.snippet: Warmup Phase Configuration Relevant source files The warmup phase is a preliminary execution stage designed to eliminate "cold-start" effects from benchmark results.
